name: TCC UniFAST - Facebook Social Post Publisher

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ $('Validate and Normalize').item.json.facebook.scheduled_for ? { message: $('Validate and Normalize').item.json.facebook.message, published: false, scheduled_publish_time: $('Validate and Normalize').item.json.facebook.scheduled_publish_time } : { message: $('Validate and Normalize').item.json.facebook.message, published: true } }}

meta.description: Import into n8n and configure TCC_UNIFAST_N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET, FACEBOOK_PAGE_ID, FACEBOOK_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN, LARAVEL_API_URL, and TCC_UNIFAST_SYNC_ENDPOINT_SECRET. The workflow fetches real Facebook Page metadata, publishes/schedules the post, and calls Laravel back with the Facebook post ID, permalink, Page profile, and final status.
